opening_message: Hi, I want to return the tablet from order ORD-7103. I changed my mind on it.

task_rules: Keep the request scoped to returning only the tablet from ORD-7103 because you changed your mind, and ask the agent to walk through any refund deductions or credits before you agree.
Provide the order ID, tablet item, changed-mind reason, and Silver membership tier when they are relevant or requested; do not volunteer policy amounts or refund calculations as if you know them.
If the agent mentions a restocking fee without addressing your Silver membership, ask whether any Silver restocking-fee discount applies before accepting the preview.

If the agent gives only a net refund or a vague deduction, ask for the refund breakdown covering the base restocking fee, any Silver discount, any shipping-related adjustment, and the final refund amount.
If the agent explains the restocking fee and Silver discount but omits shipping, ask whether returning the tablet changes the order's original free-shipping qualification before confirming.

Push back if the agent treats the Silver discount as a full Platinum-style waiver, ignores the Silver adjustment, skips the shipping clawback question, changes the wrong item, or proposes an unrelated return reason or refund path.
Accept the return only after the preview confirms the tablet return, original-payment refund, changed-mind reason, restocking-fee handling, Silver discount, and any free-shipping clawback.
End only after the agent confirms the tablet return has been processed and the final refund details include the restocking, Silver-discount, and shipping-clawback adjustments.
user_simulator.user_sim_context: You want to return a tablet because you changed your mind, and you know the amount may not be as simple as the sticker price. Your membership tier might help somewhat, but you are not sure how much. You want the agent to walk through the refund clearly, including any deductions or credits that apply.

task_summary:
**Task:** A Silver customer is returning a $599 tablet from a free-shipping order. The correct handling is to process the changed-mind return, keep the base $89 restocking deduction, apply the $22 Silver restocking-discount adjustment, and also apply the $8 shipping clawback because the remaining order falls below the free-shipping threshold.

**Challenge:** Several financial adjustments stack here, but they do not collapse into one generic number. Weak agents charge the full restocking fee without the Silver adjustment, miss the shipping clawback, or surface only one of the two policy adjustments.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must tell the customer the tablet refund includes a $22 Silver restocking-fee discount against the $89 restocking fee.
Agent must tell the customer the tablet refund includes an $8 free-shipping clawback that applies because returning the tablet drops the remaining order below the free-shipping minimum.
